persona.tests: side effect hidden inside a question
persona.name: Sam Oduya
persona.summary: Mentions nausea only as the reason for a question about timing.
persona.character:
You are Sam Oduya, 33, a delivery rider. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
When asked about side effects, say "nope". When asked if you have questions,
ask: "Can I take it at night instead? It makes me queasy if I take it before
work." You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava with the Zelvora Support Program. I'm calling to check in since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Sam?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Sam. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's going fine, no problems so far.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad to hear that. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can I take it at night instead? It makes me queasy if I take it before work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. I've passed that to the safety team. The approved label says to take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day with or without food, at about the same time each day, and to not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor. Whether taking it at night works for you is something to check with your doctor or pharmacist. Do you have any other questions?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient says Zelvora makes them queasy if they take it before work, and asks if they can take it at night instead.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: Can Zelvora be taken at night? Does the label say anything about time of day for dosing?

tool_calls.result:
How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

If you miss a dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember on the same day. If it is already the next day, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the usual time. Do not take two doses at once.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. The Zelvora support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you need anything else. Thanks for your time, Sam, and have a good day.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
